messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: 12 onboarding tenants saw intermittent high inference latency last night during a maintenance window. Need customer-facing update + outreach matrix. Draft below — please review and claim parts.

Alex (Support): I can do the in-console banner and the bulk email. Will need the exact wording for the credit and FAQ.

Jonah (Solutions): Ill own the three enterprise accounts with live integrations (will add per-account notes).

Priya (Eng): Quick RCA summary for CS: an autoscaler regression during a config rollout plus slower-than-expected warmup for one quantized model variant. Hotfix deployed at 02:15 UTC; latency normalized ~02:50 UTC. No data exposure.

Sam (Product): Keep messaging concise and non-technical. Include: what happened, actions we took, what were doing to stop recurrence, and next steps for customers.

Maya (CS): Draft copy for email/in-app (please edit):\n
Subject: Update: brief service degradation that affected onboarding jobs

Hi {{customer_name}},

Were writing to let you know about a short service disruption that affected inference latency for some customers during last nights maintenance window (Mar 20 UTC). Your account experienced elevated latencies between ~01:4202:50 UTC which may have impacted onboarding batch runs or interactive requests.

What happened (short): an autoscaling configuration regression combined with a slower warmup for a specific optimized model variant led to increased tail latency for a subset of requests. Our engineers deployed a fix and added safeguards; performance returned to normal by ~02:50 UTC.

Customer impact: possible slower responses or delayed onboarding job progress during the window. We validated recent onboarding runs and retried queued jobs where feasible. No customer data was exposed; this was an availability issue only.

What we did for you: restarted affected worker pools for onboarding, retried queued requests where possible, and verified end-to-end request success for recent runs.

Next steps: we will apply a small service credit for the impacted window (details below) and can schedule a follow-up review if youd like. If you observed failed onboarding items, reply to this message and well prioritize remediation.

How were preventing this: we deployed an autoscaler safety limiter and a conservative warmup policy for optimized variants, and were improving monitoring/alerts so we detect this earlier.

Credit and FAQ: see short FAQ below for credit timing and security assurances.

Thanks for your patience  the Redwood Support Team

\nFAQ (brief):
- When will I see the credit? Credits applied within 3 business days; Billing will confirm.
- Was my data affected? No. This was an availability issue only.
- Can you re-run failed onboarding items? Yes  reply and well prioritize.

Maya (CS): Proposed credit policy: one-off credit equivalent to 2 hours of provisioned Dedicated throughput (converted to usage credit). Billing to confirm final amounts and wording.

Alex (Support): Suggest adding link to full RCA (optional for customers who want details) once legal signs off. Also include who to contact for a technical walkthrough.

Priya (Eng): Ive started the RCA; legal review required for language. ETA 48 hours for public RCA. Will provide a placeholder link in the meantime.

Sam (Product): Agree with credit approach. For renewal-risk accounts, we should offer a proactive review call and a short remediation plan.

Jonah (Solutions): Drafts for the three high-touch accounts are ready. Ill include a short note on what we observed in their logs and proposed remediation items.

Billing: Will confirm credit amounts and timing by EOD.

Maya (CS): Owners and timeline: Alex  in-console banner + bulk email today; Jonah  personalized outreach to 3 accounts today; Priya  RCA placeholder by EOD tomorrow and final RCA in ~48h; Billing  confirm credit and apply within 3 business days; Maya  follow-up renewal-risk outreach next week. Ops Bot  tag incident and set reminders.

Ops Bot: Incident tag created: INC-2189 | Severity S2 | Owner: Priya (Eng) | Link: https://internal.incidents/INC-2189

Alex (Support): Will paste the in-console copy here before sending and log delivery.

Jonah (Solutions): Sending the three personalized emails now after a quick review.

Priya (Eng): Hotfix committed and rolled at 03:10 UTC; additional warmup policy and autoscaler backstop merged. RCA draft shared with Legal.

Maya (CS): Checklist (copy this):
- [ ] Finalize and send in-console notice (Alex)
- [ ] Send bulk email and save send logs (Alex)
- [ ] Send personalized emails (Jonah)
- [ ] Publish RCA link / placeholder (Priya + Legal)
- [ ] Apply and confirm credits for 12 accounts (Billing)
- [ ] Renewal-risk follow-up plan (Maya + Sam)

Maya (CS): Any blockers?

Alex (Support): No blockers. Ill post confirmation and send logs here when done.

Jonah (Solutions): No blockers. Sending now.

Priya (Eng): Legal review pending for RCA wording.

Maya (CS): Thanks  please mark tasks done with reactions and keep this thread updated with customer replies so we can track handoffs.

Ops Bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 7 days for customer replies and credit confirmations.
